subject: Acme - procurement & security qualification / next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Thanks — Acme discovery recap + next steps

Hi Jordan / Samir —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we can keep procurement moving: 

Summary of call:
- Use case: inference for customer-facing chat + embeddings for search (pilot ~5M tokens/month).
- Primary concerns: data isolation, SOC 2 evidence, DPA language, and procurement path (PO vs card; marketplace).
- Timeline: pilot goal to start in Nov; procurement needs to be completed before provisioning.

Action items / questions for Acme:
1) Procurement path: Do you generally purchase via PO (NetSuite/Ariba) or will a credit card/central billing be used for pilots? If PO, who is the AP contact and what billing PO format is required?
2) Marketplace interest: Would you prefer an AWS Marketplace listing to simplify invoicing and licensing?
3) Security gating: Please confirm which security artifacts you need up front (SOC 2 report, DPA redlines, security questionnaire). If you have a vendor questionnaire we can start answering, please attach.

Attachments I've included: Redwood_Security_Pack.pdf (SOC 2 summary + controls matrix), DPA_Draft_Acme.docx (our standard DPA — feel free to redline), SOW_template.pdf (if procurement needs an SOW).

Next steps (proposed):
- Jordan: confirm procurement path (PO vs card) and AP contact by EOD Thu, Oct 16.
- Samir: share any vendor questionnaire or required evidence; if you need SOC 2 report we can set up a secure share.
- Neha (cc): will follow up with SOC 2 evidence and DPA process.

I'll follow up with a single-threaded checklist and proposed DocuSign link once we get confirmation on path.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Thanks — Acme discovery recap + next steps

Thanks Marissa — good recap. A few clarifications from procurement side: 

1) Procurement path: We prefer PO via NetSuite for anything that will be on central books. For a short pilot we can sometimes use a departmental card, but Ops likes PO so invoicing flows properly. We'll need vendor remit details and Redwood's W-9/Tax ID.

2) Marketplace: AWS Marketplace would be ideal if it supports subscription or metered billing for your offering — makes legal and procurement easier. Do you have an AWS Marketplace SKU or plan to list?

3) Security artifacts: We need your SOC 2 Type II report (redacted is fine) and a completed security questionnaire — I'll attach our standard vendor security questionnaire in a follow-up email. For the DPA, legal will prefer to redline your DPA and push a few items (data residency, subprocessor list).

AP contact for PO: Linda Park, linda.park@acme.com (she handles NetSuite entries).

If you can provide: vendor remit, W-9, SOC 2, and a link to the DPA for redlines, we can start the PO process this week.

Thanks,

Jordan
Jordan Lee

jordan.lee@acme.com | +1 (212) 555-0133

Subject: Re: Thanks — Acme discovery recap + next steps (SOC 2 + DPA)

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for the quick reply and the AP contact. A few notes from our side: 

- SOC 2: We have a SOC 2 Type II report for period 2025-06 through 2026-05. I can share a redacted copy via secure share (or a link) once we confirm recipient emails. Redacted report and controls matrix are included in the Redwood_Security_Pack.pdf attached to Marissa's email — link included above.

- DPA: The attached DPA_Draft_Acme.docx is our starting point. We're happy to review redlines. For speed, we can set up a 30-min legal-to-legal call this week to triage any sticking points (subprocessors, data deletion timelines, audit rights).

- Marketplace: We are currently onboarding to AWS Marketplace — we have a private listing option and expect to support SaaS subscriptions by Q4. If Acme prefers marketplace billing, we can prioritize the listing but it typically takes ~3 weeks to finalize.

Attachments / links I'm happy to provide on request: full SOC 2 Type II report (secure link), current subprocessor list, and vendor remit/W-9.

Proposed next steps from Redwood: 
1) Marissa: confirm whether Acme will route pilot via PO or card.
2) Jordan: if PO, please send a sample PO format or AP requirements and confirm Linda Park as the entry contact.
3) Jordan / Samir: send vendor security questionnaire and we'll start filling it out (Neha to lead).
4) Legal TLDR call: propose Thu Oct 16, 10am PT — Ben / Neha / Marissa from our side.

Happy to jump on the call and get the DPA redlines in parallel.

Thanks,
